semantic_predicates: all integer fields are strict signed 64-bit values within their schema bounds
all digest fields are lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 values
all timestamps are canonical UTC seconds ending in Z
canonical_json columns equal EDGELAB_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 bytes decoded as ASCII
metadata has exactly one row with singleton runtime, formats 2/2, null authority binding, and UNANCHORED/UNKNOWN/DENY
schema_registry has exactly one row with singleton registry
seals has exactly one deterministic RUNTIME_GENESIS_IDENTITY row
legacy_archive has zero rows for NEW and exactly one singleton legacy row with V16_BOUNDED_REPLAY_ONLY for V1_MIGRATION

for V1_MIGRATION the projection blob is canonical and registered, its projection_sha256 equals the legacy projection digest recomputed without that field and source_projection_sha256, its archive_sha256 equals source_row_archive_sha256, and the archive and projection blob digests equal archive_blob_sha256 and projection_blob_sha256

snapshot_kind is exactly CHECKPOINT or EXPORT; each kind has an independently contiguous sequence starting at zero with null prior, and every later prior_document_sha256 equals the immediately prior document_sha256 of the same kind
metadata latest_checkpoint_sha256 is null exactly when no CHECKPOINT exists and otherwise equals the document_sha256 of the maximum CHECKPOINT sequence, never an EXPORT
all root row orders are ascending BINARY and form a total unique order
